description: Extreme close-up photograph of a man's left hand resting against his chin, showing a braided/ridged gold band ring on the ring finger. Only the lower face and hand are visible. The image matches widely circulated close-up crops purported to show Barack Obama's gold ring, which circulated with claims about an inscription on the band; nothing in the image itself confirms the identification or any inscription.
flags: Face is mostly out of frame; identification as Barack Obama comes from the image's known circulation context, not from a clear view of the face
Claims about an inscription on the ring are not verifiable from this image

description: Photograph of Barack Obama in sunglasses, dark blazer and open-collar white shirt walking across an airport tarmac, carrying a book in his left hand. A dark police cruiser sits in the background and a gray-haired man in a suit faces away in the right foreground. This matches a widely circulated 2008 campaign-trail photo in which the book was reported to be Fareed Zakaria's 'The Post-American World'; the title is not clearly legible in this copy.
flags: Book title identification comes from the photo's known circulation/reporting, not from legible text in this image

description: Formal portrait photograph of German Chancellor Angela Merkel standing against a plain light background, wearing a red button-front blazer over a white top with a silver necklace. Her hands are clasped in front of her in her characteristic diamond-shaped 'Merkel-Raute' gesture.

Outdoor photograph of Hillary Clinton, wearing a headband, white sweater and large cross necklace, walking beside an elderly man in a straw hat, glasses and tan jacket; a white-haired person is partly visible behind them. Clinton carries a paperback book under her arm. The image matches a widely circulated mid-1990s photo said to show Clinton with philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller at his Wyoming ranch, with the book claimed in circulation to be Paul Davies' 'Are We Alone?'; neither the man's identity nor the book title is confirmed by anything in the image itself.
flags: Elderly man widely identified in circulation as Laurance Rockefeller, but not identifiable from the image alone
Book title claim ('Are We Alone?' by Paul Davies) is from circulation context; the cover is not legible
